answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 45101 Country: India Title: Qurbani Question: I had taken loans from many people to expand my business of shoes which till now have amounted to approx 300000 rupees and the business is still the same as it was before i.e, poor. Now I am unable to repay back the loans and I have to even take a loan for Qurbani also on Eidul Azha. Please tell me whether Qurbani is mandatory for me even being in such a debt trap. Answer ID: 45101 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 710/710/M=1434) In the question mentioned above you are under the burden of debt and you do not possess such money by which you could offer sadaqah al-Fitr. Then in such situation Qurbani is not wajib on you. It is also not lawful to take interest based loan for Qurbani. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
